answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Chartmaker inked survey record filed with the atlas registry flips the bet — each inked survey is a coastal chart countersigned by the warden, so a farm must chart a hundred real coasts by hand — and the forge lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the echo of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The relic is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
